name: Cleanthes of Assos
biography: Zeno's immediate successor; notable for prosecuting (in intent) Aristarchus of Samos for impiety over heliocentrism, and for composing the 'Hymn to Zeus' and a short prayer expressing pious submission to divine Destiny, both cited by Russell as strikingly close in tone to later Christian devotional writing.
